class DifferenceStreamReader {
  #queue;
  constructor(queue) {
    this.#queue = queue;
  }
  drain() {
    const out = [...this.#queue].reverse();
    this.#queue.length = 0;
    return out;
  }

    return this.#queue.length === 0;
  }
